summary: Author native declared-resource references from TypeScript agents and missions

replay.detail: The DSL emits existing native resource reference nodes. Persisted declaration and replay interpretation are unchanged.

schema.detail: No storage schema, generated SDK or native wire-shape changes. The authoring schema adds an optional resourceReferences array using existing native subject and URI reference syntax.

rules.detail: TypeScript agents and missions accept named resourceReferences with exactly one subject or absolute URI and an optional nonblank reason. Native name and URI validation applies; duplicate reference names are rejected and author order is preserved.

compatibility.detail: The field is additive and omitted by default. Existing declarations, managed resources, kit metadata and admission budgets remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: TypeScript authoring only. No service interruption, restart, migration or backfill is required.

manual.detail: No migration is required. Authors may opt into resourceReferences when they need native declared-resource edges.

recovery.detail: No existing state is rewritten and no recovery procedure is required.
